# Restriction

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A restriction a script interpreter applied, or in audit mode would have
applied, because the script is not allowed to run unrestricted.

Appears at: `/restriction`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `error_id` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.1.0 | The interpreter's identifier for the restriction. |
| `language_mode` | [`LanguageMode`](types.md#languagemode) | no |  |  | 1.1.0 | The language mode that applies, or would apply. |
| `message` | string | no |  | 1 to 32767 characters | 1.1.0 | The interpreter's message, with the script position. |
| `title` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.1.0 | The kind of restriction, as the interpreter titles it. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
